svg.title: First steps after a collision in Canada
svg.desc: Make the scene safe, exchange information, report to police when the provincial threshold or an injury requires it, notify the insurer, then protect injury-benefit deadlines. Fault percentage is confirmed in writing before renewal. Not legal advice.
svg.text: Clocks differ by province. Figures used 24 Sep 2026. Not a quote.
1. Safety. Do not admit fault. Exchange names, plates, and insurers.
2. Police if someone is hurt, or damage meets the provincial amount.
3. Tell your insurer. Ontario injury notice: 7 days.
4. Return the accident-benefits application on time.
5. Fault percent, in writing, before renewal.
Ontario property-damage report: combined damage over $5,000 (Reg. 596).
Alberta: $5,000 combined, unchanged for 2026. B.C. police written report: $10,000.
Quebec injury claims: SAAQ, file promptly, three-year maximum. Vehicle damage: your insurer.
